data.name: Main_NoServersHint
data.value: Make your first server in a few clicks, then invite your friends to play.

data.name: Main_SelectServer
data.value: Select a server to see its details.

data.name: CreateServer_MemoryHint
data.value: Capped at 75% of this PC's memory so Windows and Minecraft stay responsive.

data.name: CreateServer_VersionsFailed
data.value: Could not load the Minecraft version list. Check your internet connection and reopen this window.

data.name: CreateServer_ChecksumFailed
data.value: A download was damaged or changed (its checksum did not match), so it was not used. Please try again.

data.name: Server_CommandHelp
data.value: Type a server command without the slash, for example: say Hello, op Steve, time set day

data.name: Server_CommandPlaceholder
data.value: Type a command, e.g. time set day

data.name: Server_NoPlayers
data.value: No one is online right now.

data.name: Server_StopOtherConfirm
data.value:
"{0}" is running, and only one server can run at a time.
Stop "{0}" and start "{1}"?

data.name: Server_ForceStopConfirm
data.value:
"{0}" is still saving after {1} seconds.
Force it to close? Anything since the last save may be lost.
Choose No to keep waiting.

data.name: Server_Error_ServerJarMissing
data.value: This server's folder has no server.jar, so it cannot start.

data.name: Server_Error_EulaNotAccepted
data.value: The Minecraft EULA has not been accepted for this server, so it cannot start.

data.name: Server_Error_AnotherServerRunning
data.value: Another server is already running. Stop it first.

data.name: CreateServer_TypeVanillaHint
data.value: The official server, exactly like the game.

data.name: CreateServer_TypePaperHint
data.value: Runs faster and supports plugins. Put plugins in the plugins folder.

data.name: CreateServer_TypeFabricHint
data.value: Supports Fabric mods. Put mods in the mods folder; most mods also need Fabric API.

data.name: Game_StopToChange
data.value: Stop the server to change the greyed-out settings. Keep inventory and the other game rules change right away.

data.name: Game_ModeHint
data.value: Players joining for the first time start in this mode.

data.name: Game_MotdHint
data.value: Shown under the server's name in Minecraft's server list.

data.name: Game_DistanceHint
data.value: In chunks. Lower numbers run smoother on a slower PC.

data.name: Game_SpawnProtectionHint
data.value: Only operators can build this many blocks around spawn. 0 turns it off.

data.name: Game_AllowFlightHint
data.value: Turn on if a mod or plugin lets players fly, so they are not kicked for it.

data.name: Game_HardcoreHint
data.value: One life only: players who die become spectators.

data.name: Game_SeedHint
data.value: Leave empty for a random world.

data.name: Game_SeedLocked
data.value: The world already exists, so its seed can no longer change.

data.name: Players_WhitelistOn
data.value: Only players on the whitelist can join

data.name: Players_WhitelistEmpty
data.value: The whitelist is on but empty, so nobody can join. Add your friends' names and your own.

data.name: Players_OperatorsHint
data.value: Operators can use every command, such as gamemode, kick and stop.

data.name: Players_InvalidName
data.value: Player names are 1 to 16 letters, numbers or underscores.

data.name: Players_Pending
data.value: Changes made while the server is stopped are applied the next time it starts.

data.name: Players_KickBanHint
data.value: To kick or ban a player, type kick <name> or ban <name> in the Console. pardon <name> lets them back in.

data.name: CreateServer_OwnerHint
data.value: The whitelist is on, so only listed players can join. Your name is added to it and made an operator the first time the server starts. You can skip this and add players later on the Players tab.

data.name: Server_NextStartHint
data.value: Changes here take effect the next time the server starts.

data.name: Server_StopToChange
data.value: Stop the server to change the port or account checks.

data.name: Server_PortHint
data.value: Friends join with your address and this number, like 192.168.1.5:{0}. The default is {1}.

data.name: Server_OnlineModeHint
data.value: Keeps people from joining under someone else's name.

data.name: Server_OnlineModeWarning
data.value: Account checks are off. Anyone can join using any name, including yours or an operator's, and can take over that player's items and progress. Only turn this off if you know why you need it.

data.name: Server_JvmArgumentsHint
data.value: Added after WaNut's own Java options. Separate options with spaces; use quotes around a value with spaces. Takes effect at the next start.

data.name: Server_JvmArgumentsHiddenNote
data.value: This server has custom JVM arguments. They still apply; turn on Advanced mode in App settings to see or change them.

data.name: Server_JvmProblem_NotAnOption
data.value: Each option must start with "-", for example -XX:+UseLargePages. The arguments were not saved.

data.name: Server_JvmProblem_Memory
data.value: Set memory with the RAM slider instead of -Xmx or -Xms. The arguments were not saved.

data.name: Server_JvmProblem_NotAllowed
data.value: WaNut chooses the server jar, so -jar, -cp, -version and -help are not allowed. The arguments were not saved.

data.name: Server_JvmProblem_UnclosedQuote
data.value: A quote is not closed. The arguments were not saved.

data.name: AppSettings_AdvancedModeHint
data.value: Shows extra options for experienced users, such as custom JVM arguments on each server's Server tab.

data.name: Server_BackupFailedConfirm
Backups_Hint
data.value: WaNut backs up the world every time the server starts. Backups hold the world only, not plugins, mods or settings.

data.name: Backups_StopToChange
data.value: Stop the server to back up or restore.

data.name: Backups_Done
data.value: Backed up! Your world is safe.

data.name: Backups_NoWorldYet
data.value: There's no world to back up yet. Start the server once to create it.

data.name: Backups_Restored
data.value: Restored the world from {0}. The world from before is kept as a backup too.

data.name: Backups_RestoreFailed
data.value: The restore failed, so the current world was left as it was: {0}

data.name: Backups_CleanupFailed
data.value: An old backup couldn't be deleted: {0} WaNut will try again next time.

data.name: Backups_Problem_UnsafeWorldName
data.value: The world name (level-name in server.properties) isn't a plain folder name, so WaNut won't back it up. Change it to a simple name such as world.

data.name: Backups_Problem_DamagedBackup
data.value: This backup file is damaged or wasn't made by WaNut, so it can't be restored. The current world was not changed.

data.name: Backups_Problem_BackupMissing
data.value: This backup file is gone. It may have been moved or deleted.

data.name: Backups_RestoreConfirm
data.value:
Restore {0} to the backup from {1}?
The current world will be replaced. WaNut backs it up first, so you can go back.

data.name: Backups_EmptyHint
data.value: The first one is made the next time the server starts.

data.name: Backups_KeepCountHint
data.value: The newest ones are kept. From 1 to 100. The default is 5. Copies made before a restore don't count here; they're deleted only by age.

data.name: Backups_MaxAgeDaysHint
data.value: From 1 to 3650. The default is 30. The newest backup is always kept, however old.

data.name: Backups_RulesShared
data.value: These rules apply to every server.
